description: Building SPHEREx Time Machine: a live web tool that streams real NASA SPHEREx data, blinks epochs to spot moving objects, and generates spectra on the fly. Python/Streamlit + astropy, proper-motion correction, variance-weighted differencing, Discovery Mode mover ranking. Validated on all five NASA test targets, deployed publicly. Seeking: front-end polish, demo video editing, science communication, data-viz. If you can make real NASA data feel magical, join us!
